items.question: Trong câu "In fs-03 you ran the app and watched the to-do list change instantly: tick a box and the item is crossed out, add a to-do and it appears at the top, and the "N left" counter follows along.", từ "instantly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In fs-03 you ran the app and watched the to-do list change instantly: tick a box and the item is crossed out, add a to-do and it appears at the top, and the "N left" counter follows along.", what does "instantly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: instantly /ˈɪn.stənt.li/ (trạng từ): ngay lập tức. Hay gặp: "update instantly" (cập nhật tức thì).
items.explanationEn: instantly /ˈɪn.stənt.li/ (adverb): immediately. Common in "update instantly".

items.question: Trong câu "Every time the data changes, your code has to find the right elements and patch them:", từ "patch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

options: sửa một phần nhỏ cho đúng
optionsEn: to mend clothes with a piece of cloth
to fix or update a small part
items.explanation: patch /pætʃ/ (động từ): sửa một phần nhỏ cho đúng. Trong IT, "patch" còn là danh từ: bản vá lỗi ("security patch").
items.explanationEn: patch /pætʃ/ (verb): to fix or update a small part. In IT, "patch" is also a noun: a fix, as in "security patch".

items.question: Trong câu "That is a classic UI bug.", từ "classic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is a classic UI bug.", what does "classic" (adjective) mean?
options: cổ điển, thuộc âm nhạc cổ điển
items.explanation: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (tính từ): điển hình, rất quen thuộc. "A classic mistake" = một lỗi kinh điển mà ai cũng từng mắc.
items.explanationEn: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (adjective): typical and well known. "A classic mistake" is one everybody has made.

items.question: Trong câu "React flips the job around.", từ "flip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "React flips the job around.", what does "flip" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: flip /flɪp/ (động từ): đảo ngược, lật lại. "Flip something around" = đảo ngược cách làm; còn nghĩa "lật đồng xu" (flip a coin).
items.explanationEn: flip /flɪp/ (verb): to turn over or reverse. "Flip something around" means to reverse it; also "flip a coin".

items.question: Trong câu "You describe what the screen should look like for the current data, and React works out which parts of the page (the DOM, the browser's live tree of elements) actually need to change:", từ "work out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You describe what the screen should look like for the current data, and React works out which parts of the page (the DOM, the browser's live tree of elements) actually need to change:", what does "work out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: work out /wɜːk aʊt/ (cụm từ): tính toán ra, tìm ra. "Work out" còn nghĩa là tập thể dục; ở đây là "tính ra, xác định".
items.explanationEn: work out /wɜːk aʊt/ (phrase): to calculate or figure out. "Work out" also means to exercise; here it means to figure out.

items.question: Trong câu "A handy way to remember it: UI = f(data).", từ "handy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A handy way to remember it: UI = f(data).", what does "handy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: handy /ˈhæn.di/ (tính từ): tiện lợi, hữu ích. "Come in handy" = có lúc dùng đến.
items.explanationEn: handy /ˈhæn.di/ (adjective): convenient and useful. "Come in handy" means to be useful at some point.

items.question: Trong câu "It also explains why many UI bugs are really data bugs: the screen faithfully shows the wrong data.", từ "faithfully" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It also explains why many UI bugs are really data bugs: the screen faithfully shows the wrong data.", what does "faithfully" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách trung thực, chính xác
items.explanation: faithfully /ˈfeɪθ.fəl.i/ (trạng từ): một cách trung thực, chính xác. Cuối thư trang trọng: "Yours faithfully".
items.explanationEn: faithfully /ˈfeɪθ.fəl.i/ (adverb): accurately, exactly as given. Also a formal letter ending: "Yours faithfully".

items.question: Trong câu "The script is src/main.jsx, the entry point:", từ "entry point" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The script is src/main.jsx, the entry point:", what does "entry point" (phrase) mean?
options: điểm bắt đầu chạy chương trình
items.explanation: entry point /ˈen.tri pɔɪnt/ (cụm từ): điểm bắt đầu chạy chương trình. Mỗi app có một entry point, ví dụ main.jsx hay index.js.
items.explanationEn: entry point /ˈen.tri pɔɪnt/ (phrase): where a program starts running. Every app has one, e.g. main.jsx or index.js.

items.question: Trong câu "Starts a dev server on port 5173, converts JSX on the fly, forwards /api to port 4000 (the proxy in vite.config.js)", từ "on the fly" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: on the fly /ɒn ðə flaɪ/ (cụm từ): ngay khi cần, trong lúc chạy. Trái với "ahead of time" (làm trước).
items.explanationEn: on the fly /ɒn ðə flaɪ/ (phrase): as needed, while running. The opposite of "ahead of time".

items.question: Trong câu "Hot reload (HMR, Hot Module Replacement): the change appears in the browser in a split second, usually without losing what you typed", từ "split second" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hot reload (HMR, Hot Module Replacement): the change appears in the browser in a split second, usually without losing what you typed", what does "split second" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: split second /ˌsplɪt ˈsek.ənd/ (cụm từ): khoảnh khắc rất ngắn. Thường dùng: "in a split second", "a split-second decision".
items.explanationEn: split second /ˌsplɪt ˈsek.ənd/ (phrase): a very brief moment. Used in "in a split second", "a split-second decision".

options: thu nhỏ code bằng cách bỏ khoảng trắng và rút gọn tên
optionsEn: to shrink code by removing spaces and shortening names
items.explanation: minify /ˈmɪn.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): thu nhỏ code bằng cách bỏ khoảng trắng và rút gọn tên. Code đã minify ("minified") khó đọc nhưng tải nhanh hơn.
items.explanationEn: minify /ˈmɪn.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to shrink code by removing spaces and shortening names. Minified code is hard to read but loads faster.

items.question: Trong câu "What gets deployed is the dist/ folder, not your dev server.", từ "deploy" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: deploy /dɪˈplɔɪ/ (động từ): đưa phần mềm lên môi trường chạy thật. Danh từ: "deployment" (một lần triển khai).
items.explanationEn: deploy /dɪˈplɔɪ/ (verb): to release software to a live environment. Noun: "deployment".

items.question: Trong câu "A component is a reusable piece of UI written as a JavaScript function that returns what to show.", từ "reusable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: reusable /ˌriːˈjuː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be used again. Noun: "reuse".

items.question: Trong câu "Components nest inside each other, forming a component tree:", từ "nest" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: nest /nest/ (verb): to fit one inside another. "Nested" appears in "nested components", "nested lists".

items.question: Trong câu "className instead of class (because class is a JavaScript keyword)", từ "keyword" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: keyword /ˈkiː.wɜːd/ (noun): a word reserved by a programming language. JS keywords include class, return, function.

items.question: Trong câu "A component returns one parent element (wrap siblings in a <div>, <section> or <>…</>)", từ "sibling" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: sibling /ˈsɪb.lɪŋ/ (noun): an element at the same level. In a tree: parent, child, sibling.

items.question: Trong câu "A component returns one parent element (wrap siblings in a <div>, <section> or <>…</>)", từ "wrap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.question: Trong câu "A component tree is a free checklist for a mockup review: each box is a component, and each component has its own states to specify (see section 9).", từ "mockup" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: mockup /ˈmɒk.ʌp/ (noun): a sample design of a screen. Related: wireframe, prototype.

items.question: Trong câu "A component tree is a free checklist for a mockup review: each box is a component, and each component has its own states to specify (see section 9).", từ "specify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: specify /ˈspes.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to state clearly and in detail. Noun: "specification" (spec).

items.question: Trong câu "Props (short for properties) are the inputs of a component, passed from the parent like attributes.", từ "attribute" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

a quality of a person's character

items.explanationEn: attribute /ˈæt.rɪ.bjuːt/ (noun): a property set on an HTML tag. E.g. type, value, placeholder on <input>.

items.question: Trong câu "Think of a component as a function and props as its arguments: TodoPage(user, onLogout) in spirit.", từ "argument" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: argument /ˈɑːɡ.jə.mənt/ (noun): a value passed into a function. Everyday sense: a quarrel. In code: a value passed to a function.

một cách chính xác từng chữ
items.explanation: in spirit /ɪn ˈspɪr.ɪt/ (cụm từ): về tinh thần, về bản chất. Trái với "literally" (theo nghĩa đen).
items.explanationEn: in spirit /ɪn ˈspɪr.ɪt/ (phrase): in essence, roughly speaking. The opposite of "literally".

items.explanationEn: callback /ˈkɔːl.bæk/ (noun): a function passed in to be called later. Everyday sense: a return call; in code: a function called back later.

items.explanationEn: hand down /hænd daʊn/ (phrase): to pass down from parent to child. Also for traditions: "handed down from generation to generation".

items.explanationEn: hook /hʊk/ (noun): a special React function whose name starts with use. Examples: useState, useEffect.

items.explanationEn: setter /ˈset.ər/ (noun): a function that sets a new value. Paired with "getter".

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: change state only through the setter.", từ "rule of thumb" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (phrase): a practical, easy-to-remember guideline. Not a strict law, but practical experience.

items.explanationEn: simplified /ˈsɪm.plɪ.faɪd/ (adjective): made simpler. Verb: "simplify".

items.question: Trong câu "Wiring it to the API is the next topic, fs-05.", từ "wire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Wiring it to the API is the next topic, fs-05.", what does "wire" (verb) mean?
options: kết nối (code) với thành phần khác
optionsEn: to connect code to another part
items.explanation: wire /waɪər/ (động từ): kết nối (code) với thành phần khác. "Wire up" = nối các phần lại với nhau.
items.explanationEn: wire /waɪər/ (verb): to connect code to another part. "Wire up" means to connect parts together.

items.question: Trong câu "React compares old and new values; if you change the old array in place, React may not notice and the screen does not update.", từ "in place" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "React compares old and new values; if you change the old array in place, React may not notice and the screen does not update.", what does "in place" (phrase) mean?
options: sửa trực tiếp trên chính đối tượng đó
items.explanation: in place /ɪn pleɪs/ (cụm từ): sửa trực tiếp trên chính đối tượng đó. Khác với "in place of" (thay cho). "Everything is in place" = mọi thứ đã sẵn sàng.
items.explanationEn: in place /ɪn pleɪs/ (phrase): changing the same object directly. Unlike "in place of". "Everything is in place" means ready.

items.question: Trong câu "Here todos is gone on refresh unless it is reloaded from the server; filter survives because it is also saved in localStorage.", từ "survive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Here todos is gone on refresh unless it is reloaded from the server; filter survives because it is also saved in localStorage.", what does "survive" (verb) mean?
options: còn tồn tại, không bị mất
optionsEn: to stay alive after an accident
items.explanation: survive /səˈvaɪv/ (động từ): còn tồn tại, không bị mất. Trong IT: dữ liệu "survives a restart/refresh" = không mất khi khởi động lại.
items.explanationEn: survive /səˈvaɪv/ (verb): to remain, not be lost. In IT: data that "survives a restart" is not lost.

items.question: Trong câu "The key must be stable and unique: the database id is perfect.", từ "stable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key must be stable and unique: the database id is perfect.", what does "stable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (tính từ): không thay đổi, ổn định. Danh từ "stable" là chuồng ngựa. "Stable release" = bản phát hành ổn định.
items.explanationEn: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (adjective): not changing. As a noun, a building for horses. "Stable release" is a reliable version.

items.question: Trong câu "The key must be stable and unique: the database id is perfect.", từ "unique" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key must be stable and unique: the database id is perfect.", what does "unique" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: the only one of its kind, no duplicates
items.explanation: unique /juˈniːk/ (tính từ): duy nhất, không trùng. Trong database: "unique constraint" (ràng buộc không trùng).
items.explanationEn: unique /juˈniːk/ (adjective): the only one of its kind, no duplicates. In databases: "unique constraint".

items.question: Trong câu "Using the position in the array (0, 1, 2…) breaks down when you delete or filter, because "row 1" suddenly means a different to-do and React may reuse the wrong row.", từ "break down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Using the position in the array (0, 1, 2…) breaks down when you delete or filter, because "row 1" suddenly means a different to-do and React may reuse the wrong row.", what does "break down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: break down /breɪk daʊn/ (cụm từ): ngừng hoạt động đúng, hỏng. "Break down a task" còn nghĩa là chia nhỏ công việc.
items.explanationEn: break down /breɪk daʊn/ (phrase): to stop working correctly. "Break down a task" also means to split it into parts.

items.question: Trong câu "Forget the key and React prints a warning in the Console:", từ "warning" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Forget the key and React prints a warning in the Console:", what does "warning" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a message about a possible problem
an error that stops the program
items.explanation: warning /ˈwɔː.nɪŋ/ (danh từ): lời cảnh báo. Warning không làm dừng app, khác với error.
items.explanationEn: warning /ˈwɔː.nɪŋ/ (noun): a message about a possible problem. Unlike an error, a warning does not stop the app.

items.question: Trong câu "Conditional rendering means showing different JSX depending on the data.", từ "conditional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Conditional rendering means showing different JSX depending on the data.", what does "conditional" (adjective) mean?
options: có điều kiện, tùy theo điều kiện
items.explanation: conditional /kənˈdɪʃ.ən.əl/ (tính từ): có điều kiện, tùy theo điều kiện. Ngữ pháp: "conditional sentence" (câu điều kiện).
items.explanationEn: conditional /kənˈdɪʃ.ən.əl/ (adjective): depending on a condition. Grammar: "conditional sentence".

items.question: Trong câu "TodoPage chains two ternaries to pick one of three states for the list area:", từ "chain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TodoPage chains two ternaries to pick one of three states for the list area:", what does "chain" (verb) mean?
options: nối tiếp nhiều cái với nhau
optionsEn: to tie up with a chain
to link several things one after another
items.explanation: chain /tʃeɪn/ (động từ): nối tiếp nhiều cái với nhau. Danh từ "chain": sợi xích, chuỗi cửa hàng.
items.explanationEn: chain /tʃeɪn/ (verb): to link several things one after another. As a noun: a metal chain, a chain of stores.

items.question: Trong câu "TodoPage chains two ternaries to pick one of three states for the list area:", từ "ternary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TodoPage chains two ternaries to pick one of three states for the list area:", what does "ternary" (noun) mean?
options: toán tử ba ngôi a ? b : c
items.explanation: ternary /ˈtɜː.nər.i/ (danh từ): toán tử ba ngôi a ? b : c. Gọi là "ternary" vì có ba phần: điều kiện, giá trị đúng, giá trị sai.
items.explanationEn: ternary /ˈtɜː.nər.i/ (noun): the a ? b : c operator. Named for its three parts: condition, true value, false value.

items.question: Trong câu "That is exactly the kind of question a BA should raise before build, not after.", từ "raise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is exactly the kind of question a BA should raise before build, not after.", what does "raise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: raise /reɪz/ (động từ): nêu ra, đưa ra. "Raise a concern / a question / a bug" = nêu ra.
items.explanationEn: raise /reɪz/ (verb): to bring up for discussion. "Raise a concern / a question / a bug".

items.question: Trong câu "These are derived values: anything you can compute from existing state.", từ "derived" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These are derived values: anything you can compute from existing state.", what does "derived" (adjective) mean?
options: được suy ra, tính ra từ thứ khác
optionsEn: obtained or calculated from something else
items.explanation: derived /dɪˈraɪvd/ (tính từ): được suy ra, tính ra từ thứ khác. Động từ: "derive from" (bắt nguồn từ, suy ra từ).
items.explanationEn: derived /dɪˈraɪvd/ (adjective): obtained or calculated from something else. Verb: "derive from".

items.question: Trong câu "These are derived values: anything you can compute from existing state.", từ "compute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These are derived values: anything you can compute from existing state.", what does "compute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: compute /kəmˈpjuːt/ (động từ): tính toán. Họ từ: computer, computation.
items.explanationEn: compute /kəmˈpjuːt/ (verb): to calculate. Family: computer, computation.

items.question: Trong câu "With a derived value, the count cannot disagree with the list; it is recalculated from the single source of truth, todos.", từ "disagree" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With a derived value, the count cannot disagree with the list; it is recalculated from the single source of truth, todos.", what does "disagree" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: disagree /ˌdɪs.əˈɡriː/ (động từ): không khớp, mâu thuẫn. Ở đây: hai con số không khớp nhau; nghĩa thường: không đồng ý.
items.explanationEn: disagree /ˌdɪs.əˈɡriː/ (verb): to not match, contradict. Here: two figures do not match; usually: to hold a different opinion.

items.question: Trong câu "With a derived value, the count cannot disagree with the list; it is recalculated from the single source of truth, todos.", từ "source of truth" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With a derived value, the count cannot disagree with the list; it is recalculated from the single source of truth, todos.", what does "source of truth" (phrase) mean?
options: nguồn dữ liệu gốc, đáng tin duy nhất
items.explanation: source of truth /ˌsɔːs əv ˈtruːθ/ (cụm từ): nguồn dữ liệu gốc, đáng tin duy nhất. Hay gặp: "single source of truth" (SSOT).
items.explanationEn: source of truth /ˌsɔːs əv ˈtruːθ/ (phrase): the one authoritative data origin. Often "single source of truth" (SSOT).

items.question: Trong câu "Note the business rule hidden in this line: "N left" counts all unfinished to-dos, whatever filter is selected.", từ "unfinished" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note the business rule hidden in this line: "N left" counts all unfinished to-dos, whatever filter is selected.", what does "unfinished" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unfinished /ʌnˈfɪn.ɪʃt/ (tính từ): chưa xong. Tiền tố "un-" mang nghĩa phủ định.
items.explanationEn: unfinished /ʌnˈfɪn.ɪʃt/ (adjective): not yet done. The prefix "un-" means not.

items.question: Trong câu "Write them down in plain words in the requirements, so the developer and the tester implement and check the same rule.", từ "implement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Write them down in plain words in the requirements, so the developer and the tester implement and check the same rule.", what does "implement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (động từ): hiện thực hóa, cài đặt. Danh từ: "implementation" (sự triển khai, bản cài đặt).
items.explanationEn: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (verb): to put into effect, build. Noun: "implementation".

items.question: Trong câu "Keep the browser and your editor side by side.", từ "side by side" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep the browser and your editor side by side.", what does "side by side" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: side by side /ˌsaɪd baɪ ˈsaɪd/ (cụm từ): cạnh nhau. "Side-by-side comparison" = so sánh đặt cạnh nhau.
items.explanationEn: side by side /ˌsaɪd baɪ ˈsaɪd/ (phrase): next to each other. "Side-by-side comparison".

items.question: Trong câu "If something breaks, Vite shows a red error overlay in the browser and the terminal prints the file and line.", từ "overlay" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If something breaks, Vite shows a red error overlay in the browser and the terminal prints the file and line.", what does "overlay" (noun) mean?
options: lớp phủ hiện đè lên trang
optionsEn: a layer shown on top of the page
items.explanation: overlay /ˈəʊ.və.leɪ/ (danh từ): lớp phủ hiện đè lên trang. Trong UI: modal, overlay, tooltip là các lớp hiện đè.
items.explanationEn: overlay /ˈəʊ.və.leɪ/ (noun): a layer shown on top of the page. In UI: modals, overlays and tooltips sit on top of the page.

items.question: Trong câu "You can even edit a value there to try a state without clicking through the app.", từ "click through" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can even edit a value there to try a state without clicking through the app.", what does "click through" (phrase) mean?
options: bấm qua lần lượt các bước/màn hình
optionsEn: to click step by step through screens
items.explanation: click through /klɪk θruː/ (cụm từ): bấm qua lần lượt các bước/màn hình. "Click-through rate" (CTR) trong marketing là tỷ lệ nhấp.
items.explanationEn: click through /klɪk θruː/ (phrase): to click step by step through screens. In marketing, "click-through rate" (CTR).

items.question: Trong câu "Now "that's a one-line change" from a developer is something you can picture, and you can check a bug report's claim ("the count is wrong") directly in the Components tab.", từ "picture" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Now "that's a one-line change" from a developer is something you can picture, and you can check a bug report's claim ("the count is wrong") directly in the Components tab.", what does "picture" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: picture /ˈpɪk.tʃər/ (động từ): hình dung, tưởng tượng. Danh từ "picture" là bức tranh; động từ là hình dung.
items.explanationEn: picture /ˈpɪk.tʃər/ (verb): to imagine clearly. As a noun, an image; as a verb, to imagine.

items.question: Trong câu "Now "that's a one-line change" from a developer is something you can picture, and you can check a bug report's claim ("the count is wrong") directly in the Components tab.", từ "claim" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Now "that's a one-line change" from a developer is something you can picture, and you can check a bug report's claim ("the count is wrong") directly in the Components tab.", what does "claim" (noun) mean?
options: yêu cầu bồi thường bảo hiểm
optionsEn: a statement said to be true
items.explanation: claim /kleɪm/ (danh từ): lời khẳng định. Claim chưa chắc đã đúng; cần kiểm chứng ("verify a claim").
items.explanationEn: claim /kleɪm/ (noun): a statement said to be true. A claim may be untrue; you "verify a claim".

items.question: Trong câu "What shows, and whether buttons are disabled (Please wait… on the login button)", từ "disabled" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What shows, and whether buttons are disabled (Please wait… on the login button)", what does "disabled" (adjective) mean?
options: bị vô hiệu hóa, không bấm được
items.explanation: disabled /dɪˈseɪ.bəld/ (tính từ): bị vô hiệu hóa, không bấm được. Trái nghĩa: enabled.
items.explanationEn: disabled /dɪˈseɪ.bəld/ (adjective): turned off, cannot be clicked. Opposite: enabled.

items.question: Trong câu "The message, and any call to action ("Add your first to-do")", từ "call to action" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The message, and any call to action ("Add your first to-do")", what does "call to action" (phrase) mean?
options: lời kêu gọi hành động (nút/đường dẫn)
optionsEn: a prompt urging the user to act
items.explanation: call to action /ˌkɔːl tu ˈæk.ʃən/ (cụm từ): lời kêu gọi hành động (nút/đường dẫn). Viết tắt CTA, ví dụ nút "Buy now".
items.explanationEn: call to action /ˌkɔːl tu ˈæk.ʃən/ (phrase): a prompt urging the user to act. Abbreviated CTA, e.g. a "Buy now" button.

items.question: Trong câu "Exact wording, where it appears, when it disappears", từ "wording" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exact wording, where it appears, when it disappears", what does "wording" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: wording /ˈwɜː.dɪŋ/ (danh từ): cách diễn đạt, câu chữ. Thường dùng trong review: "Please check the wording".
items.explanationEn: wording /ˈwɜː.dɪŋ/ (noun): the exact words used. Often in reviews: "Please check the wording".

items.question: Trong câu "For every screen in a user story, list the loading, empty, error and success states in the acceptance criteria and draw each one in the mockup.", từ "acceptance criteria" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For every screen in a user story, list the loading, empty, error and success states in the acceptance criteria and draw each one in the mockup.", what does "acceptance criteria" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: conditions a feature must meet to be accepted
items.explanation: acceptance criteria /əkˈsep.təns kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ə/ (cụm từ): tiêu chí nghiệm thu. "Criteria" là số nhiều của "criterion".
items.explanationEn: acceptance criteria /əkˈsep.təns kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ə/ (phrase): conditions a feature must meet to be accepted. "Criteria" is the plural of "criterion".

items.question: Trong câu "Component reuse means consistency.", từ "consistency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Component reuse means consistency.", what does "consistency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consistency /kənˈsɪs.tən.si/ (danh từ): sự nhất quán. Tính từ: "consistent"; trái nghĩa: "inconsistency".
items.explanationEn: consistency /kənˈsɪs.tən.si/ (noun): being the same everywhere. Adjective: "consistent"; opposite: "inconsistency".

items.question: Trong câu "When you write requirements, reuse names too: say "the standard error message" or "the same empty state as the Orders list", and a developer can map it to an existing component instead of building a slightly different copy.", từ "map" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you write requirements, reuse names too: say "the standard error message" or "the same empty state as the Orders list", and a developer can map it to an existing component instead of building a slightly different copy.", what does "map" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to link one thing to a matching one
items.explanation: map /mæp/ (động từ): ánh xạ, đối chiếu sang. Cũng là hàm .map trong JavaScript: biến mỗi phần tử thành một thứ khác.
items.explanationEn: map /mæp/ (verb): to link one thing to a matching one. Also JavaScript's .map: turns each item into something else.

items.question: Trong câu "Ask in refinement: "Is there already a component for this?"", từ "refinement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ask in refinement: "Is there already a component for this?"", what does "refinement" (noun) mean?
options: buổi làm rõ và ước lượng backlog
optionsEn: a session to clarify and estimate backlog items
items.explanation: refinement /rɪˈfaɪn.mənt/ (danh từ): buổi làm rõ và ước lượng backlog. Trong Scrum: "backlog refinement" (trước đây gọi là grooming).
items.explanationEn: refinement /rɪˈfaɪn.mənt/ (noun): a session to clarify and estimate backlog items. In Scrum: "backlog refinement" (formerly grooming).

items.question: Trong câu "A yes usually means a smaller estimate and fewer UI inconsistencies to test.", từ "estimate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A yes usually means a smaller estimate and fewer UI inconsistencies to test.", what does "estimate" (noun) mean?
options: con số ước lượng công sức
items.explanation: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.mət/ (danh từ): con số ước lượng công sức. Động từ đọc là /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.mət/ (noun): an approximate figure for effort. The verb is pronounced /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/.

items.question: Trong câu "React lets you describe what the screen should look like for the current data; it updates the DOM for you (UI = f(data)).", từ "describe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "React lets you describe what the screen should look like for the current data; it updates the DOM for you (UI = f(data)).", what does "describe" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to say what something is like
items.explanation: describe /dɪˈskraɪb/ (động từ): mô tả. Danh từ: "description".
items.explanationEn: describe /dɪˈskraɪb/ (verb): to say what something is like. Noun: "description".

items.question: Trong câu "Props pass data and callbacks down (user, onLogout); data flows down, events flow up.", từ "flow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Props pass data and callbacks down (user, onLogout); data flows down, events flow up.", what does "flow" (verb) mean?
options: chảy, di chuyển theo một hướng
optionsEn: to move steadily in one direction
items.explanation: flow /fləʊ/ (động từ): chảy, di chuyển theo một hướng. "Data flow" = luồng dữ liệu; "user flow" = luồng thao tác của người dùng.
items.explanationEn: flow /fləʊ/ (verb): to move steadily in one direction. "Data flow"; "user flow".

items.question: Trong câu "State from useState (todos, newTitle, filter) is changed only through its setter, and each change triggers a re-render.", từ "trigger" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State from useState (todos, newTitle, filter) is changed only through its setter, and each change triggers a re-render.", what does "trigger" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ər/ (động từ): kích hoạt, gây ra. Danh từ: "trigger" (tác nhân kích hoạt), ví dụ database trigger.
items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ər/ (verb): to cause something to start. Noun: a trigger, e.g. a database trigger.

items.question: Trong câu "Conditional rendering covers loading, empty (Nothing here yet.) and error (&&) states, and derived values (visible, remaining) are computed, not stored.", từ "cover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Conditional rendering covers loading, empty (Nothing here yet.) and error (&&) states, and derived values (visible, remaining) are computed, not stored.", what does "cover" (verb) mean?
options: hát lại bài của người khác
optionsEn: to perform a song by another artist
items.explanation: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ (động từ): bao gồm, xử lý đủ. "Test coverage" = mức độ bao phủ của test.
items.explanationEn: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ (verb): to include and deal with. "Test coverage".

items.question: Trong câu "Conditional rendering covers loading, empty (Nothing here yet.) and error (&&) states, and derived values (visible, remaining) are computed, not stored.", từ "store" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Conditional rendering covers loading, empty (Nothing here yet.) and error (&&) states, and derived values (visible, remaining) are computed, not stored.", what does "store" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: store /stɔːr/ (động từ): lưu trữ. Danh từ "store" là cửa hàng; "storage" là nơi lưu trữ.
items.explanationEn: store /stɔːr/ (verb): to keep for later use. As a noun, a shop; "storage" is where things are kept.

items.question: Trong câu "Point to the file that starts the app and the component that picks the screen", từ "point to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Point to the file that starts the app and the component that picks the screen", what does "point to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: point to /pɔɪnt tuː/ (cụm từ): chỉ ra, chỉ vào. Trong code: "a pointer" (con trỏ) trỏ tới một vị trí.
items.explanationEn: point to /pɔɪnt tuː/ (phrase): to show where something is. In code, a pointer points to a location.

items.question: Trong câu "Sketch a screen as a component tree and name its props and state", từ "sketch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sketch a screen as a component tree and name its props and state", what does "sketch" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sketch /sketʃ/ (động từ): phác thảo nhanh. Danh từ: "a sketch" (bản phác); cũng là tên một công cụ thiết kế.
items.explanationEn: sketch /sketʃ/ (verb): to draw quickly and roughly. Noun: a sketch; also a design tool name.

items.question: Trong câu "Inspect props and state with React DevTools", từ "inspect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Inspect props and state with React DevTools", what does "inspect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: inspect /ɪnˈspekt/ (động từ): xem xét kỹ. Trong Chrome: chuột phải → "Inspect" để mở DevTools.
items.explanationEn: inspect /ɪnˈspekt/ (verb): to examine closely. In Chrome: right-click → "Inspect" opens DevTools.

items.question: Trong câu "fs-05 connects this screen to the backend: forms, fetch through api.js, and showing the server's error messages.", từ "connect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "fs-05 connects this screen to the backend: forms, fetch through api.js, and showing the server's error messages.", what does "connect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: connect /kəˈnekt/ (động từ): kết nối, nối với. Danh từ: "connection".
items.explanationEn: connect /kəˈnekt/ (verb): to join or link together. Noun: "connection".
